title: Little Maggie
source: Traditional Appalachian song. Text as sung by G. B. Grayson (1887-1930) and Henry Whitter (1892-1941), "Little Maggie with a Dram Glass in Her Hand", Victor V-40135 (recorded New York, 1 August 1928, matrix BVE-46639; issued 1929), the earliest recording; checked against Richard L. Matteson Jr.'s transcription of that record (2009). Stanzas 1, 2, 3 and 6 of the recording, in its own words.
attribution: Little Maggie - Traditional (Appalachian). Chord arrangement by Self-Guitar contributors, released under CC0.
